name: Mahou ga Sekai o Sukuimasu!
original_name: 魔法が世界を救います！
source:
From the shadows "magicians" protect the order of the world. 

Several years ago in a place known to noone the protagonist (named Kreutz) has lost his powers in a battle where the stake has been the world itself. Now, according to his master's will, he arrived in town to protect his daughters. Due to unexpected events Kreutz ended up teaching magic to Flora, one of the daughters, to make her a full-fledged magician.

Will Flora manage to become a magician? Is Kreutz able to cut his ties with his past? Can they thwart the plans of the evil "magician" who's just appeared?

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=242345]Getchu.com[/url]]
translation:
“魔法师”在暗中守护着世界秩序。

数年前，在一个无人知晓的地方，主人公克罗伊茨曾参加一场赌上世界命运的战斗，并在其中失去了力量。如今，他遵照师父的意愿来到城镇，保护师父的女儿们。由于意外事件，克罗伊茨开始教授其中一名女儿芙萝拉魔法，帮助她成为独当一面的魔法师。

芙萝拉能否顺利成为魔法师？克罗伊茨能否斩断与过去的联系？他们能否挫败刚刚现身的邪恶“魔法师”的计划？

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=242345]Getchu.com[/url]]
